messages.content: Please check whether flight AA100 is on time, and if it is, book it for Jordan Lee in business class. Then send me a high-priority email notice with the gate board for AA100, and also send me a high-priority email weather alert for New York. Please look up Hilton Tokyo as well, and notify alice by high-priority email that the travel itinerary was processed. After that, book the best meeting room for 6 attendees on 2026-01-15 from 14:00 to 15:00. Finally, create a backup of the /workspace/travel_ops workspace named trip_meeting_bundle_backup. This is for user_01, and the notification channel should be email.
